description: This file implements serialization and deserialization logic for Web requests and responses, including handling of HTTP headers, content types, encoding, chunked transfer, and WebSocket extensions. It defines classes and methods for converting internal data structures to and from wire format, managing state during parsing and serialization, and handling compression and signature data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods for serialization and deserialization, managing headers, body, and request parameters.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for serialization and deserialization, managing headers, status, and body.

methods.name: Request::Serializer::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Request object into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Response::Serializer::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Response object into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Request::Deserializer::Parse
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream data into a Request object, handling headers, body, and transfer encoding.

methods.name: Response::Deserializer::Parse
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream data into a Response object, handling headers, body, and transfer encoding.

methods.name: Request::Deserializer::EndOfPassThrough
methods.description: Finalizes the parsing of a request body after transfer is complete.

methods.name: Response::Deserializer::EndOfPassThrough
methods.description: Finalizes the parsing of a response body after transfer is complete.

methods.name: Request::Deserializer::EndOfLine
methods.description: Handles the end of a line during parsing, updating parser state accordingly.

methods.name: Response::Deserializer::EndOfLine
methods.description: Handles the end of a line during parsing, updating parser state accordingly.
